description: Quick Start overview: guests, CPU, memory, GPU, SDXI and RDMA/TCP mesh at a glance.

panels.title: Guests Up
panels.description: Number of VMs where node-exporter is reachable. Requires <vm-extra-hostfwd> tcp::9100-:9100 and prometheus-node-exporter running in the guest.

panels.title: ROCm Ernic Instances
panels.description: Number of ernic NIC instances registered with the rocm-ernic mesh manager, as reported by the ernic-stats-exporter.

panels.title: RDMA Fleet Throughput
panels.description: Fleet-total RDMA byte rate broken out by operation type: SEND, RECV, RDMA Read, RDMA Write. From ernic-stats-exporter.

panels.title: TCP Mesh Fleet Throughput
panels.description: Total TCP/IP bytes per second over the ernic TAP network (fleet total TX + RX). This is the Ethernet layer beneath the RDMA mesh.

panels.title: GPU Up
panels.description: Number of guests with at least one GPU bound to the amdgpu driver, from amdgpu_devices_total, which each guest writes for node-exporter's textfile collector. 0 until amdgpu has been probed in the guest; `qemu-tool quick-start test` does that.

panels.title: SDXI Copy Throughput
panels.description: Fleet-total bytes per second copied by the guests' SDXI devices, from sdxi_bytes_moved_total, which each guest writes for node-exporter's textfile collector. The rate is taken over 2 minutes, eight of the guests' 15 s writes. No data on a fleet with no SDXI device.

panels.title: CPU Busy % Per VM
panels.description: CPU busy percentage per VM (100 − idle%), derived from node_cpu_seconds_total. Averaged across all vCPUs for each VM.

panels.title: Memory Used % Per VM
panels.description: Percentage of memory in use per VM: 100 × (1 − MemAvailable / MemTotal). Current snapshot, not a time series.

panels.title: System Load 1m Per VM
panels.description: 1-minute load average (node_load1) per VM. A value above the vCPU count indicates CPU saturation.

panels.title: Memory Available Per VM
panels.description: Bytes of memory available for new allocations (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes) per VM over time.

panels.title: NVMe I/O Per VM
panels.description: NVMe (nvme0n1) read and write throughput in bytes per second per VM, from node-exporter disk stats.

panels.title: NVMe IOPS Per VM
panels.description: NVMe (nvme0n1) read and write I/O operations per second per VM, from node-exporter.

panels.title: SDXI Device Up
panels.description: Whether each guest read its SDXI device's counters (sdxi_up, written by sdxi-textfile-metrics.timer in the guest). "no counters" is the right answer for a guest with no SDXI device, which is every guest of a fleet with <sdxi-per-vm>0. For a guest that has one it means the read failed, and `journalctl -u sdxi-textfile-metrics.service` in the guest says why. No tile at all means the guest has no exporter: an image baked before it, until `qemu-tool quick-start test` installs it.

panels.title: SDXI Errors (dashboard range)
panels.description: Operations the SDXI device failed, per VM, over the time range the dashboard is showing, all contexts. One failed operation is one count, so a single failure turns its tile red until it leaves the range.

panels.title: SDXI Copy Throughput Per VM
panels.description: Bytes per second copied by each guest's SDXI device, from sdxi_bytes_moved_total of context 1, the context every client operation runs in. Each guest writes the counters for node-exporter's textfile collector every 15 s and the rate is taken over 2 minutes, eight of those: a steady workload reads within about 13% of its rate, and a short burst shows as its bytes spread over 2 minutes.

panels.title: SDXI Copies/s Per VM
panels.description: Copy operations per second completed by each guest's SDXI device, from sdxi_num_copy_total of context 1. Each guest writes the counters for node-exporter's textfile collector every 15 s and the rate is taken over 2 minutes, eight of those: a steady workload reads within about 13% of its rate, and a short burst shows as its bytes spread over 2 minutes.

panels.title: SDXI Compress / Decompress Bytes/s Per VM
panels.description: Uncompressed bytes per second through each guest's SDXI device: the input of compress operations and the output of decompress operations, which is what the two counters count. Each guest writes the counters for node-exporter's textfile collector every 15 s and the rate is taken over 2 minutes, eight of those: a steady workload reads within about 13% of its rate, and a short burst shows as its bytes spread over 2 minutes.

panels.title: SDXI Compress / Decompress Ops/s Per VM
panels.description: Compress and decompress operations per second completed by each guest's SDXI device. Each guest writes the counters for node-exporter's textfile collector every 15 s and the rate is taken over 2 minutes, eight of those: a steady workload reads within about 13% of its rate, and a short burst shows as its bytes spread over 2 minutes.

panels.title: rocm-ernic0 (ionic)
panels.description: Counts VMs where rocm-ernic0 is visible to node-exporter. Present = ionic driver is loaded and bound.

panels.title: ionic_rdma (RDMA exporter up)
panels.description: Counts VMs where rdma-metrics-exporter is reachable. Up = ionic_rdma module is loaded.
VMs with IB port in ACTIVE state from rdma_exporter hardware counters.
panels.title: IB Port Active

panels.description: RDMA link speed label from rdma_port_info per VM.
panels.title: Link Speed

panels.description: RDMA byte rates from rdma_exporter hardware counters on the ionic device (send/recv/read/write). Device-level, complementing ernic-stats mesh-level counters above.
panels.title: RDMA Bytes/s Per Device

panels.description: RDMA command rate per device from rdma_exporter. Admin queue commands to the ionic RDMA device.
panels.title: RDMA Commands/s Per Device
RDMA Throughput — Fleet Total
panels.description: Fleet-total RDMA byte rate broken out by operation type: SEND, RECV, RDMA Read, RDMA Write. From ernic-stats-exporter.

panels.title: RDMA By Node
panels.description: RDMA bytes per second per ernic node (current snapshot). Shows which nodes are active in the mesh.

panels.title: TCP Mesh Fleet Traffic
panels.description: TCP/IP bytes per second on the ernic TAP Ethernet network per direction (TX/RX). This carries RDMA signalling and out-of-band exchange.

panels.title: Doorbells & Completions — Fleet Total
panels.description: RDMA queue pair activity: send/recv doorbells ring when a WQE is posted; CQEs and WQEs track completions. A proxy for RDMA operation rate.

panels.title: RDMA Traffic By Node
panels.description: Per-node RDMA send/recv byte rate over time. Useful for spotting asymmetric traffic or stalled nodes.

Logs of the stack's containers -- the ernic, rocjitsu and SDXI device servers, QEMU, Prometheus and Grafana -- shipped to Loki by Alloy. Only present when <logs-enable> is true. Nothing here comes from inside a guest.
panels.title: Stack Logs (Alloy → Loki)
